name: Molten Pilgrim
lore: A volcanic snail carrying a living furnace. Crawling is painfully slow and dodge travels only 28% as far. Learn to aim Shellbound from one lava patch to the next; the airborne arc is visible, but does not make you invulnerable.

primary.name: Furnace Breath
primary.description: A short 130-range lava burst deals 32 damage and burns for 1 per second for 3s. Leaves non-stacking lava patches: 3 damage per second while standing in them.

secondary.name: Shellbound
secondary.description: Lob yourself up to 460 over 0.8s. Land for 22 splash damage, a mild 3s burn and lava patches dealing 3 damage per second. Walls stop travel; flight is not invulnerable.

special.name: Backdraft Volcano
special.description: For 6s, your shell erupts with two lava balls every 0.5s. Each lands for 12 damage and leaves lava. Overlapping lava patches do not stack their damage.

passive: Melting Presence: Enemies within 155 lose up to 40 percentage points of damage reduction (60% becomes 20%). Cannot reduce protection below zero or cancel invulnerability. Does not stack with another snail.

technique.name: Long Migration
technique.description: Shellbound reaches 600 instead of 460, but impact falls from 22 to 14 damage.

final_technique.name: Caldera Crown
final_technique.description: Replace the moving 6s volcano with a warned ring eruption around your current spot. Deals 60 once per foe and leaves eight lava patches for 6s; the centre is safe.

attack.name: Caldera Crown
attack.description: Warn for 0.75s, then erupt an eight-patch lava ring at 120 radius. A foe hit by overlapping patches takes the initial 60 only once. Lava lasts 6s.
